notes.title: Project Atlas - Initial Budget
notes.content: The initial approved budget for Project Atlas is INR 500000. This budget covers development, hosting, testing, and initial launch expenses.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Revised Budget
notes.content: The Project Atlas budget has been revised from INR 500000 to INR 750000. The additional allocation is for expanded testing and infrastructure requirements. The revised budget replaces the earlier budget.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Original Launch Date
notes.content: The original planned launch date for Project Atlas is 2026-11-10. The team expects the initial release to include authentication, knowledge ingestion, and basic search.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Launch Postponement
notes.content: The Project Atlas launch has been postponed from 2026-11-10 to 2026-12-05 because additional retrieval testing is required. The new planned launch date is 2026-12-05.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Initial Technology Stack
notes.content: The initial technology stack for Project Atlas consists of React for the frontend, FastAPI for the backend, and PostgreSQL for persistent storage.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Vector Search Added
notes.content: The Project Atlas architecture has been expanded to use PostgreSQL with pgvector for vector similarity search. The existing PostgreSQL database remains in use, with pgvector supporting semantic retrieval.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Initial Team Ownership
notes.content: During the initial planning phase, the backend implementation and API integration were assigned to the platform team. The frontend implementation was assigned to the product interface team.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Ownership Reassignment
notes.content: From November 1, the product engineering team owns both backend API integration and frontend implementation for Project Atlas. The earlier split ownership arrangement is no longer current.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Initial Retrieval Target
notes.content: The initial retrieval quality target for Project Atlas is 80 percent. This target applies to the first internal evaluation round.

notes.title: Project Atlas - Updated Retrieval Target
notes.content: The retrieval quality target for Project Atlas has been increased from 80 percent to 92 percent. The updated target will be used for the evaluation scheduled on 2026-11-25.
